thought.text: The guide references Liquibase 5.0.1 — v5.0.4 is the same 5.0.x line. Downloading:

reasoning_content:
Wait, Liquibase's latest release is v5.0.4? That doesn't seem right — Liquibase 4.x has long been the stable line. Actually, Liquibase released 5.x in 2025 (5.0.0 in February 2025). The guide states `liquibase-5.0.1`, so v5.0.4 is perfect — the guide is explicitly requesting the 5.0.x line.

Let me download liquibase-5.0.4.zip from the GitHub release (release assets are on github.com → objects.githubusercontent.com, which is resolvable).

action.command: cd /opt && timeout 300 curl -sSL -o liquibase.zip "https://github.com/liquibase/liquibase/releases/download/v5.0.4/liquibase-5.0.4.zip" && unzip -q liquibase.zip && rm liquibase.zip && export LIQUIBASE_HOME=/opt/liquibase-5.0.4 && $LIQUIBASE_HOME/liquibase --version 2>&1 | head -4

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /opt && timeout 300 curl -sSL -o liquibase.zip \"https://github.com/liquibase/liquibase/releases/download/v5.0.4/liquibase-5.0.4.zip\" && unzip -q liquibase.zip && rm liquibase.zip && export LIQUIBASE_HOME=/opt/liquibase-5.0.4 && $LIQUIBASE_HOME/liquibase --version 2>&1 | head -4", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Install Liquibase 5.0.4 from GitHub"}
